Company Milestones: A Journey of Innovation and Growth # General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. (GPI) has a rich history marked by continuous innovation, expansion, and commitment to quality. Below is a structured timeline of the company’s key milestones, reflecting its evolution in the imaging supplies industry.
1978 - 1989: Foundation and Early Expansion # 1978
GPI was established by Chairman Mr. Jack Wang, laying the foundation for future growth.
1986
The company expanded into plastic molding production, specializing in toner cartridges for copiers and printers.
1990 - 1999: Scaling Up and Quality Focus # 1995
A second plant was set up, increasing the number of production lines to seven.
1996
Initiated ISO 9002 implementation to enhance quality management.
1997
Achieved ISO 9002 certification, demonstrating a commitment to quality standards.
1998
Continued efforts to improve quality through ISO 9002 processes.
1999
Developed and successfully introduced OPC drum bases to the market, establishing capabilities in manufacturing complex OPC bases. Upgraded gears to JIS4 standards. In October, GPI developed precision gears with a 60mm outside diameter for copiers and began mass production.
2000 - 2009: Corporate Transformation and Brand Establishment # 2000
The company name was changed to General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. in April. In May, GPI issued stocks, and by August, total capital increased to 9.7 million USD.
2001
Shares were listed on the OTC market (Code: 6128).
2002
In April, mass production began for the first model of “All in one” complex laser printer toner cartridges, with several additional models developed.
2003
Shares transitioned to listing on the TWSE.
2006
Total capital increased to 22.6 million USD.
2008
The “Cartridge Web” brand was created for the finished goods wholesale market, focusing on toner cartridges for printers.
2009
The “Cartridge Web” brand was further developed, seeking regional distributors and wholesalers. Total capital increased to 47.5 million USD.
GPI was founded by the Chairman, Mr. Jack Wang. ISO 9002 certified Created Cartridge Web brand for finished goods wholesale market on toner cartridge for printers. 2010 - Present: Diversification and Global Expansion # 2010
Construction began on a hotel building in the Taichung Harbor region.
2012
Achieved ISO 14001 certification, reinforcing environmental management standards.
2013
Grand opening of the Taichung Harbor Hotel in March.
2018
Completed the 100% acquisition of Katun Holdings LP, the world’s largest distributor of aftermarket imaging supplies. Capital was further increased by cash.
2021
Attained ISO 13485 certification, demonstrating compliance with medical device quality management standards.
ISO 14001 certified Grand opening Taichung Harbor Hotel in March. 100% acquisition of Katun Holdings LP, the world’s largest distributor of aftermarket imaging supplies For more information about GPI and its brands, visit www.gpi.com.tw or explore the Cartridge Web website.
